List Villager Tiers

Source: R/data.R
villager_tiers.Rd

Lists the five villager trading tiers and the cumulative experience a villager needs to unlock each tier in Minecraft Bedrock 1.26.30.5.

Usage

villager_tiers()

Value

A base data frame with five rows:

  • tier (integer) is the numeric tier used by villager_trades().

  • tier_name (character) is the corresponding in-game rank.

  • total_exp_required (double) is the cumulative trading experience the villager needs to unlock the tier. The novice tier is always available.

Details

The bundled vanilla profession tables use the same tier names and experience thresholds. Calling this function performs no download.

Examples

villager_tiers()
#>   tier  tier_name total_exp_required
#> 1    1     novice                  0
#> 2    2 apprentice                 10
#> 3    3 journeyman                 70
#> 4    4     expert                150
#> 5    5     master                250
